item: POST /api/sources/import resolves the shipped catalog from the repo root and binds list tags as the comma-joined string (R330)
summary: The route climbed four directories from src/api/, one above the repo root, and answered 500 (FileNotFoundError) on every install; behind it the import bound the catalog's YAML tags LIST to a string column and failed on the first row. The route now uses src.paths.repo_root() (configs is a sibling of src in a checkout and in a wheel) and the import joins list tags. A test runs the real import of the shipped catalog into a throwaway database and fails on either old behaviour. Stated limit: the wheel layout is argued from the packaging config, not tested here.
